name: gov-phase6-promotion-gate
title: Phase 6 · Promotion+门禁一（availableRevisions/promote/逐句manifest核验）
description: 路径A PROD段创建侧：availableRevisions(合格过滤：冻结+来源工单FINISHED+manifest每句pre_exec=SUCCESS+未被promotion消费+当前用户有PROD资源权限+逻辑库有PROD绑定)；promote接口(入参仅revisionId+description，请求体出现sql/dsId直接抛参数异常；门禁一7条含逐句manifest核验→建promotion[绑定快照+execution_key=SHA256(revision_id+prod_ds_id+logical_db_id) UNIQUE]→用冻结SQL全集创建PROD DM_CHANGE工单)；promotionList/promotionDetail(含gate_result证据)；Promotion薄状态机(CREATED→APPROVING→APPROVED→CONFIRMED→EXECUTING→SUCCEEDED/REJECTED/FAILED/CANCELLED，状态迁移集中单点)。验收：只能选到合格revision；门禁逐条DENY可验证；夹带参数被拒。spec §4.3/§4.4/§8.1-P6。前置：Phase 4。
